scope: App.js integration with actual import helper, WorkshopStore reducer and real STL/Three geometry; controlled JSDOM and IndexedDB contract.
limitations: Does not certify visual rendering, actual browser IndexedDB persistence or hardware behavior.
A write already in flight when the drawer is closed may leave unassociated STL bytes; the dossier remains unchanged.
New parts remain unassigned and unqualified. No slicing or printing is triggered.

checks.description: No default unit or process; empty, partial and invalid choices perform no parsing, file read or asset write.
Mixed mm/FDM and inch/resin files retain their explicit choices and original destination when the active dossier changes during reading.
Two submissions in one interval read and append the source only once.
Closing the import while arrayBuffer is pending produces no parsing, asset write or piece addition after reading returns.
A concurrent destination revision interrupts the lot without overwriting the revised dossier or attaching a stale part.
After one asset storage failure, retry only reads and adds the remaining source; the already-added part and its bytes remain unchanged.
Dropping an STL preserves a draft brief, Jarvis command and existing STL setup instead of replacing the open panel.
Closing after parsing while storage is in flight attaches no piece; an already-started byte write may remain as an unassociated asset.
The explicit import keeps labelled required controls and status text; reduced-motion CSS covers the drawer and the UI toggle preserves input.
